items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Probably Nathan East was on bass.

ctx.x: You mentioned family. I remember up in Berkeley, at the Berkeley Jazz Festival in the early ’80s, I remember the whole family. Then you had a group with the family,
and you brought them up to the Berkeley Jazz Festival. Ndugu was on drums. Probably Nathan East was on bass. How long was that ensemble together?

I did not have the family included in every situation, but whenever I could include them, I did. For instance, we played Carnegie Hall a couple times. We also did the Pavilion here. That’s when the Family LP came out, because Debra is pretty much – I always get her involved when there’s space for it. She just went to Manila with us, Philippines, because I wrote a couple of pieces that – message songs, I call them – that she projects pretty well, very well in fact. She – I estimate her to be the most talented in…
